_about: What each app/service is and what can safely be done about it. 'remove' = user-removable store app (TV: Apps > Settings > Delete, or tizenpure debloat --apply); 'disable' = only hideable/disableable in the TV's own Apps settings; 'keep' = needed or requested; 'system' = part of the TV, cannot be removed or stopped (it restarts itself).

org.tizen.netflix-app.note: Preloaded in the background at boot by Samsung.

9Ur5IzDKqV.TizenYouTube.note: Runs on Samsung's Cobalt engine (com.samsung.tv.cobalt-yt), preloaded at boot.

org.tizen.primevideo.note: Preloaded in the background at boot.

1DqYLzzOyv.fsro.what: Focus Sat (M7 satellite operator app, Romania).

vbUQClczfR.Wuakitv.what: Rakuten TV: film rental/store and free ad-supported channels.
vbUQClczfR.Wuakitv.note: Streaming; removable if you never use it.

Jz7aUrV2Q4.Twitch.note: Streaming; removable if you never use it.

org.tizen.apple.apple-music.note: Preinstalled; deletable in Apps settings if unused.

WSRedi0001.WorkspaceRedi.what: Samsung Workspace: remote PC / Microsoft 365 / cloud desktop.

yL49PNFmjW.PromotionApp.what: Samsung Promotion: shows Samsung offers and ads.

25emanual2.emanual.note: Harmless; Samsung's offline manual. Usually cannot be deleted.

com.samsung.tv.gaminghub.note: System app: can be hidden from Home, not deleted.

com.samsung.tv.store.note: Needed to install and update apps.

org.tizen.browser.note: System app; preloaded in the background.

com.samsung.tv.targeted-ad-service.what: Targeted advertising service (ad selection for Smart Hub).
com.samsung.tv.targeted-ad-service.how: Privacy Choices: Interest-Based Advertisement off; DNS safe list blocks its servers.

com.samsung.tv.acr.what: Automatic content recognition (identifies what you watch).
com.samsung.tv.acr.how: Privacy Choices: Viewing Information Services off; DNS blocks samsungacr.com.

com.samsung.tizen.samsung-analytics.how: Privacy Choices off; DNS safe list blocks telemetry.

com.samsung.tv.ad-web-framework.what: Ad rendering framework for Smart Hub banners.

org.tizen.multi-assistant-service.how: Settings > General > Voice: Voice Wake-up off; assistant off if unused.

com.samsung.tv.ondevice-voice.how: Voice Wake-up off reduces activity; the mic button still works.

com.samsung.tv.bixby-prov.how: Do not sign in to Bixby if unused.

com.samsung.tv.buds-scanner.how: Restarts itself; Bluetooth off if you never use Bluetooth audio.

com.samsung.tv.MultiControl-Service.what: Multi Control: share keyboard/mouse with a Samsung PC/phone.
com.samsung.tv.MultiControl-Service.how: Settings > Connection > Multi Control off (if present).

com.samsung.tv.content-tiles-provider.what: Fills Samsung Home rows with recommended content.
com.samsung.tv.content-tiles-provider.how: Privacy Choices: personalised recommendations off; DNS aggressive list blocks feeds.
